verses.text: When I am in trouble, I pray,
“Come and save me, LORD, from deceitful liars!”
What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.

footnotes.text: Meshech … Kedar: Meshech was a country near the Black Sea, and Kedar was a tribe of the Syrian desert.

verses.text: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
